items.title: 10.10.2 Electron par charge ka hisab (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.10.2, printed pages 223-224.

blocks.text: Namoona hisab 34 min tak 0.20 A current istemal karta hai. Shuru mein anode ki mass 56.53 g, aakhir mein 56.40 g, to hataya gaya copper 0.13 g hai. Guzra charge Q = I x t = 0.20 x 34 x 60 = 408 C. Chunke 0.13 g copper ko 408 C chahiye, 1 g ko 408 / 0.13 C, aur 63.5 g (1 mole) ko 408 / 0.13 x 63.5 = 199292 C chahiye. Electrolysis ka muadla Cu2+(aq) + 2e- se Cu(s) dikhata hai ke fi mole copper 2 moles electrons chahiye. Is liye 1 mole electrons par charge = 199292 / 2 = 99646 C. Ek electron ka charge 1.60 x 10^-19 C ho to L = 99646 / (1.60 x 10^-19) = 6.2 x 10^23 mol-1, jo sahih qeemat 6.02 x 10^23 mol-1 se achhi mutabiqat rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne likha hai ke 63.5 g copper ko 408 / 0.13 x 63.5 = 99646 C chahiye. Yeh zarb (multiplication) ghalat hai: 408 / 0.13 x 63.5 = 199292 C (taqreeban 199300 C) banta hai. Yeh ek mole copper ka charge hai, jis ke liye 2 moles electrons chahiye. Is liye 1 mole electrons ka charge 199292 / 2 = 99646 C hai, aur aage L = 6.2 x 10^23 mol-1 wala jawab sahi rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: 30.0 min tak 0.500 A ka current 0.503 g silver jama karta hai (molar mass 107.87 g mol-1, Ag+). Is data se Avogadro's number nikalein (exercise Q.2j).
blocks.explanation: Q = 0.500 x 1800 = 900 C. Silver ke moles = 0.503 / 107.87 = 4.66 x 10^-3 mol, har ek ko ek electron chahiye, to fi mole electrons charge 900 / 4.66 x 10^-3 = 1.93 x 10^5 C. 1.60 x 10^-19 C par taqseem karne se NA = 1.2 x 10^24 mol-1, maqbool qeemat se taqreeban dugna, jo dikhata hai ke sawal mein silver ki mass charge se mutabiq nahi; maqbool Faraday 96500 C ke saath data 0.1006 g silver deta.

items: 34 min tak 0.20 A: 408 C 0.13 g Cu hatata hai, to 63.5 g ko 199292 C chahiye, yani 1 mole electrons ko 99646 C; electron charge 1.60 x 10^-19 C par taqseem karne se L = 6.2 x 10^23 mol-1 (sahih 6.02 x 10^23).
